description: A short team check-in: progress, plans, blockers.
context: A daily standup. Bullet leads are the person's name; keep each person's update to what they said.

sections.heading: Progress Since Last Standup
sections.instructions: One bullet per person led by their name with what they finished or moved forward.

sections.heading: Plans Until Next Standup
sections.instructions: One bullet per person led by their name with what they will do next.

sections.heading: Blockers and Help Needed
sections.instructions: Blockers and requests for help, led by the person's name. Omit the section when there are none.

sections.heading: Announcements
sections.instructions: Team-wide announcements and decisions that are not one person's update.
